description: A utility class for validating and checking query parameters such as limit, size, and skip, including bounds validation and error handling.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for validating query parameters like limit, size, and skip, enforcing min/max constraints and throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: checkLimit
methods.description: Validates and returns the limit parameter within specified max limit boundaries.

methods.name: checkSize
methods.description: Validates and returns the size parameter within specified max size boundaries.

methods.name: checkSkip
methods.description: Validates and returns the skip parameter ensuring it is within valid min/max bounds.

methods.name: checkMinLimit
methods.description: Ensures the limit is not negative.

methods.name: checkMinSize
methods.description: Ensures the size is not negative.

methods.name: checkMinSkip
methods.description: Ensures the skip value is not negative.

methods.name: checkMinParamValue
methods.description: Generic method to check for minimum value constraint on a parameter.

methods.name: checkMaxSkip
methods.description: Ensures the skip value does not exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE.

methods.name: checkMaxLimit
methods.description: Ensures the limit does not exceed a specified maximum.

methods.name: checkMaxSize
methods.description: Ensures the size does not exceed a specified maximum.

methods.name: checkMaxParamValue
methods.description: Generic method to check for maximum value constraint on a parameter.
